stock-real-data-research.prompt: Read ${LOCAL_SKILLS}/stock-real-data-research.md for full instructions. Execute the complete pipeline: (1) connect to Fidelity via CDP port 9222 and extract cookies, (2) query all GraphQL endpoints for quotes, positions, sentiment, news, and events, (3) apply Munger 7 mental models and 5 consensus principles, (4) calculate MSFT total economic exposure, (5) check portfolio rules compliance, (6) generate bilingual HTML report following ${SRC_ROOT}/DESIGN.md, (7) save to Stock Analysis folder, open in Edge, and move to Reports tab group. Also create a session log MD file alongside the report.
stock-real-data-research.description: Generate stock strategy report using live Fidelity data, Munger models, and investment principles. Requires user presence (Fidelity session cookies).

constraints.notes: Fidelity session cookies expire after ~30min idle. User must be logged in on the VM before triggering.
